definitions.text_mt: Emipleġija; paraliżi li taffettwa naħa waħda biss tal-ġisem.

usage_examples.mt: Il-pazjent ibati minn filġa wara l-attakk tal-qalb.
usage_examples.en: The patient suffers from hemiplegia after the heart attack.

usage_examples.mt: Il-filġa ħallietu mingħajr moviment fin-naħa xellugija ta' ġismu.
usage_examples.en: The hemiplegia left him without movement on the left side of his body.

definitions.text_mt: Il-ġestjoni tal-flus, tal-kapital u tar-riżorsi ekonomiċi.

usage_examples.mt: Jaħdem fil-qasam tal-finanzi.
usage_examples.en: He works in the field of finance.

usage_examples.mt: Il-finanzi tal-pajjiż huma f'kundizzjoni tajba.
usage_examples.en: The country's finances are in good condition.

definitions.text_mt: Persuna li tinvesti ammonti kbar ta' flus f'impriżi kummerċjali.

usage_examples.mt: Il-finanzier investa miljuni ta' ewro fil-kumpanija l-ġdida.
usage_examples.en: The financier invested millions of euros in the new company.

definitions.text_mt: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-finanzi jew mal-ġestjoni tal-flus.

usage_examples.mt: Is-sitwazzjoni finanzjarja tal-familja tjiebet din is-sena.
usage_examples.en: The family's financial situation improved this year.

usage_examples.mt: Għandna bżonn parir finanzjali qabel ninvestu.
usage_examples.en: We need financial advice before we invest.

definitions.text_mt: L-għoti ta' fondi meħtieġa għal attività, proġett jew impriża.

usage_examples.mt: Il-proġett irċieva finanzjament mill-gvern.
usage_examples.en: The project received financing from the government.

usage_examples.mt: Qed ifittxu finanzjament għar-riċerka xjentifika.
usage_examples.en: They are seeking financing for the scientific research.

definitions.text_mt: L-għoti ta' fondi għal xi skop; finanzjament.

usage_examples.mt: Il-finanzjar tal-iskema se jitlesta dalwaqt.
usage_examples.en: The financing of the scheme will be completed soon.

definitions.text_mt: Mil-lat finanzjarju; fir-rigward tal-flus u r-riżorsi.

usage_examples.mt: Il-kumpanija qed tmur tajjeb finanzjarjament.
usage_examples.en: The company is doing well financially.

usage_examples.mt: Finanzjarjament, is-sitwazzjoni hija stabbli.
usage_examples.en: Financially, the situation is stable.

definitions.text_mt: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-finanzi, mal-ġestjoni tal-flus jew mal-kapital.

usage_examples.mt: Is-sena finanzjarja tibda f'Jannar u tispiċċa f'Diċembru.
usage_examples.en: The financial year starts in January and ends in December.

usage_examples.mt: Is-suq finanzjarju huwa volatili bħalissa.
usage_examples.en: The financial market is volatile at the moment.

definitions.text_mt: Tal-Finlandja, tal-poplu Finlandiż jew tal-lingwa Finlandiża.

usage_examples.mt: Il-kultura Finlandiża hija rikka fl-istorja u n-natura.
usage_examples.en: Finnish culture is rich in history and nature.

usage_examples.mt: Il-lingwa Finlandiża hija differenti ħafna minn dik Svediża.
usage_examples.en: The Finnish language is very different from Swedish.

definitions.text_mt: Persuna li ġejja mill-Finlandja.
Il-lingwa Uralika uffiċjali tal-Finlandja.

usage_examples.mt: Il-kultura Finlandiża hija rikka fl-istorja u n-natura.
usage_examples.en: Finnish culture is rich in history and nature.

usage_examples.mt: Il-lingwa Finlandiża hija differenti ħafna minn dik Svediża.
usage_examples.en: The Finnish language is very different from Swedish.

definitions.text_mt: Pajjiż fl-Ewropa ta' Fuq, wieħed mill-pajjiżi Nordiċi.
Isem uffiċjali: Repubblika tal-Finlandja.

usage_examples.mt: Il-Finlandja hija magħrufa għas-silġ, il-foresti u s-sawna tagħha.
usage_examples.en: Finland is known for its snow, forests and sauna.

usage_examples.mt: Żort il-Finlandja s-sajf li għadda u rajt ix-xemx ta' nofsillejl.
usage_examples.en: I visited Finland last summer and saw the midnight sun.

etymology_chain.definition: to be alone, to do alone, to retire

definitions.text_mt: Qatta' ħaġa f'biċċiet; qasam.
Tbegħed jew ifred ħaġa minn oħra; wassal biex ma jibqgħux flimkien.

usage_examples.mt: Fired il-ħobża f'biċċiet u qasamhom ma' ħutu.
usage_examples.en: He split the loaf into pieces and shared them with his siblings.

usage_examples.mt: Fired il-ġlieda qabel ma bdiet bis-sħiħ.
usage_examples.en: He separated the fight before it started fully.

definitions.text_en: to spread out, to spread something over a surface
definitions.text_mt: Ferrex ħaġa fuq wiċċ; għatti wiċċ b'xi ħaġa.

usage_examples.mt: Firex it-tapit il-ġdid fuq l-art tas-salott.
usage_examples.en: He spread the new carpet on the living room floor.

usage_examples.mt: Firex il-friex fuq is-sodda qabel ma mar jorqod.
usage_examples.en: He spread the sheets on the bed before going to sleep.

definitions.text_mt: Kappa jew mantell twil jintlibes fuq il-ħwejjeġ, speċjalment f'ċerimonji reliġjużi.

usage_examples.mt: Il-qassis libes il-firjol aħmar għaċ-ċerimonja solenni.
usage_examples.en: The priest wore the red ferraiolo for the solemn ceremony.

usage_examples.mt: Il-firjol huwa libsa tradizzjonali li tintlibes f'okkażjonijiet formali tal-knisja.
usage_examples.en: The ferraiolo is a traditional garment worn on formal church occasions.

definitions.text_mt: Malajr; minnufih; f'daqqa.

usage_examples.mt: Ġi fis hawn! Għandna bżonnok.
usage_examples.en: Come here at once! We need you.

usage_examples.mt: Jekk ma tagħmilx fis, se nkunu tard.
usage_examples.en: If you don't do it quickly, we will be late.

definitions.text_en: Used other than figuratively or idiomatically: see f’,‎ il-,‎ skiet.
definitions.text_mt: Użat b'tifsira mhux figurattiva: ara f', il-, skiet.
Fis-skiet totali; mingħajr ebda ħoss.
B'mod sieket u mingħajr storbju.
B'mod kwiet u paċifiku.

definitions.text_en: without speaking (during something or about something)
definitions.text_mt: Mingħajr ma titkellem waqt xi ħaġa jew dwar xi ħaġa.

usage_examples.mt: Il-klassi baqgħet tistenna fis-skiet il-wasla tal-għalliem.
usage_examples.en: The class waited in silence for the teacher's arrival.

usage_examples.mt: Għadda l-lezzjoni kollha fis-skiet mingħajr ma qal kelma.
usage_examples.en: He spent the whole lesson in silence without saying a word.

usage_examples.mt: Qagħdu fis-skiet waqt li kienu qed jisimgħu l-aħbarijiet.
usage_examples.en: They sat quietly while listening to the news.

definitions.text_mt: Malajr; minnufih.

usage_examples.mt: Agħmel fisa x-xogħol għax qed jistennewk.
usage_examples.en: Do the work quickly because they are waiting for you.

definitions.text_mt: Geżwer (tarbija) bil-ħrieqi jew bil-fisqija.

usage_examples.mt: Fisqet lit-tarbija bil-ħrieqi qabel ma poġġietha torqod.
usage_examples.en: She swaddled the baby with the cloth before putting her to sleep.

usage_examples.mt: Ommu fisqatha sewwa biex iżżommha sħuna fix-xitwa.
usage_examples.en: Her mother swaddled her well to keep her warm in winter.

definitions.text_mt: Ħrieqi jew drapp li jintuża biex tgeżwer tarbija.

usage_examples.mt: Xtrajt fisqija ġdida ratba għat-tarbija li għadha kif twieldet.
usage_examples.en: I bought a new soft swaddling cloth for the newborn baby.

usage_examples.mt: Il-fisqija żżomm lit-tarbija sħuna u komda waqt l-irqad.
usage_examples.en: The swaddling cloth keeps the baby warm and comfortable during sleep.

definitions.text_mt: Fissat; sod; li ma jinbidilx.

usage_examples.mt: Għandu skeda fissa għal kull jum tal-ġimgħa.
usage_examples.en: He has a fixed schedule for every day of the week.

usage_examples.mt: Il-prezz huwa fiss u ma jinbidilx matul is-sena.
usage_examples.en: The price is fixed and does not change during the year.

definitions.text_mt: Iffissar eċċessiv fuq ħsieb jew idea waħda; manija.

usage_examples.mt: Għandu fissazzjoni fuq il-logħob tal-kompjuter u ma jaħseb f'xejn ieħor.
usage_examples.en: He has a fixation on video games and thinks of nothing else.

usage_examples.mt: Il-fissazzjoni tagħha fuq l-indafa hija estrema.
usage_examples.en: Her fixation on cleanliness is extreme.

definitions.text_mt: Ħassar billi tatih wisq attenzjoni jew affarijiet; għamel ħsara lil.
Għoġġob; żamm bil-għożża u bl-attenzjoni żejda.
Kien indulġenti ma'; ħalla jagħmel kulma jrid.
Għożż bil-mod u bl-imħabba.
Għożż bil-mod bil-ponot tas-swaba'.

usage_examples.mt: Fissed lit-tifel bl-ikel ħelu u issa ma jridx jiekol ikel ieħor.
usage_examples.en: He spoiled the child with sweets and now he won't eat other food.

usage_examples.mt: Ommu fissedtu wisq meta kien żgħir u sar imqareb.
usage_examples.en: His mother pampered him too much when he was little and he became naughty.

usage_examples.mt: Fissed il-klieb bil-mod wara widnejhom.
usage_examples.en: He stroked the dogs gently behind their ears.

definitions.text_mt: Kellu t-tifsira ta'; indika.
Kien ifisser xi ħaġa; kellu sinifikat.
Spjega; ta spjegazzjoni ċara ta'.
Interpreta; ta t-tifsira jew is-sinifikat ta'.

usage_examples.mt: X'tfisser din il-kelma bl-Għarbi?
usage_examples.en: What does this word mean in Arabic?

usage_examples.mt: Fisserli t-tifsira tal-poeżija Passi tal-Imħabba.
usage_examples.en: Explain to me the meaning of the poem Passi tal-Imħabba.

usage_examples.mt: Il-profeta fisser il-ħolma tar-re.
usage_examples.en: The prophet interpreted the king's dream.

definitions.text_mt: Persuna li tispjega jew tinterpreta testi, ideat jew sitwazzjonijiet.

usage_examples.mt: Il-fissier ta d-dettalji kollha tal-kuntratt b'mod ċar.
usage_examples.en: The interpreter gave all the details of the contract clearly.

usage_examples.mt: Il-fissier kien meħtieġ fil-qorti biex jispjega t-testi legali.
usage_examples.en: The interpreter was needed in court to explain the legal texts.

etymology_chain.definition: pipe, tube, especially a water pipe

definitions.text_mt: Kanal anormali li jgħaqqad organu ma' ieħor jew ma' wiċċ tal-ġisem.
Persuna tedjanti jew ta' fastidju.

usage_examples.mt: Il-kirurgu neħħa l-fistla b'operazzjoni delikata.
usage_examples.en: The surgeon removed the fistula with a delicate operation.

usage_examples.mt: Telaq ix-xogħol għax il-maniġer huwa fistla vera.
usage_examples.en: He left the job because the manager is a real nuisance.
